evidence.source_established_issue: The old later close TimeoutError masked the primary waveOut failure and skipped executor.shutdown. Broad modal unwinding also lacked owned active-loop guards.
evidence.unproven: ExitMainLoop alone is not a proven cause: wxWidgets v3.2.8 Yield already processes idle and pending deletions. The new native run must measure actual ordinary Close acceptance/HWND death.

changes: Preserve primary failure; attempt every independent player, recorded PlaybackOwner, ordinary host Close and existing executor even if an earlier cleanup fails.
Capture exact HWND/cancel/executor before destruction. Ordinary Close runs before original-loop exit; actual HWND death is authoritative and the old destroy-event marker remains diagnostic.
End only the exact recorded owned modal whose recorded loop is currently running; queue another turn before considering a resumed parent.
Run an actual passive playback modal and real existing frame.run_job failure before the unchanged strict playback scenario.
Explicit failure-cleanup-only mode exercises the same actual owner/worker/Close path and cannot satisfy the ordinary playback report.
